UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated RIAD AI operator profile synchronized after Google Sign-In.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this operator profile.

email.description: Verified Gmail / Google account email address.

displayName.description: Operator display name from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on initial creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on login via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private authenticated operator profile documents isolated strictly per user UID.
